scenes.description: Depth gauge counter animates downward from 0m. As the gauge crosses 5m a red color band fades to grey. At 25m orange fades. At 50m yellow fades. Remaining spectrum collapses to pure blue. Dark navy background. Narration runs over the animation. Word-level karaoke captions at bottom.
scenes.framing: Centered depth gauge with animated color spectrum strip on left side. Caption bar at 15% from bottom.
scenes.movement: Depth counter ticks downward continuously. Color bands dissolve in sequence. No camera movement.
scenes.information_role: Viewer immediately sees the color-stripping phenomenon in motion before it is explained
scenes.shot_intent: Make the viewer feel the descent before they understand it — visceral first, explanation second

required_assets.description: Remotion depth_gauge_counter component: animated counter 0-200m, color band strip dissolving at 5m/25m/50m

scenes.description: Stat card on dark blue background. Large centered text: '200m — only blue remains.' Subtitle: 'What's stripping each color away?' Narration pause creates visual breathing room before the mechanism answer.
scenes.framing: Full-bleed dark navy. Center-aligned text block. Caption strip at bottom.
scenes.movement: Text fades in on a 0.4s dissolve. Subtitle fades in 0.6s after headline.
scenes.information_role: Anchors the 200m depth fact and opens the knowledge gap — viewer needs to know why
scenes.shot_intent: Pause the visual tempo here; the question mark creates forward momentum into the mechanism section

scenes.description: Mermaid SVG diagram of a water molecule (H2O) with O-H bonds labeled. Animated sequence: red photon arrow approaches → bond oscillates → photon absorbed (label: 'absorbed'). Blue photon arrow shown passing through with label 'passes through'. Clean white-on-dark layout.
scenes.framing: Diagram occupies center 60% of frame. Left-aligned narration caption. Label overlay 'O-H bond vibrational resonance' fades in at 21s.
scenes.movement: Diagram elements animate in sequentially: molecule first, then photon arrows, then labels. Static layout once built.
scenes.information_role: Viewer sees the molecular mechanism — WHY red is absorbed. This is the core explanation.
scenes.shot_intent: Make the invisible visible — a water molecule doing something is more memorable than a verbal explanation alone

required_assets.description: Mermaid-generated SVG: H2O molecule diagram with O-H bonds, red photon absorption annotation, blue photon pass-through annotation

scenes.description: Two-line text card on dark background. Line 1: 'The molecule vibrates.' Line 2 (delayed 0.5s): 'The photon vanishes.' Minimal — just the words, dark blue background, center-aligned. Carries the emotional weight of the mechanism conclusion.
scenes.framing: Centered text. Large type weight. No additional graphics.
scenes.movement: Each line fades in independently with 0.5s stagger.
scenes.information_role: The mechanism summary — viewer internalizes the two-step process in a memorable, stripped-down form
scenes.shot_intent: Rhythm break — after the diagram, a clean text moment to let the mechanism land before the stat

scenes.description: Hero stat card: large '50×' centered on deep blue background. Below: 'Red absorbed 50 times faster than blue'. Small attribution: 'Pope & Fry 1997, Applied Optics'. Number animates in with a short scale-up pulse. Repeated narration 'Fifty times.' coincides with the number settling.
scenes.framing: Full-bleed. Oversized number dominates frame. Text below is half the scale.
scenes.movement: 50× scales up from 80% to 100% over 0.4s then settles. Subtitle fades in 0.6s after.
scenes.information_role: The anchor quantitative fact — 50x is the memorable number the viewer carries away
scenes.shot_intent: This is the video's single most shareable still frame — the 50x number must be bold and unambiguous

scenes.description: Horizontal bar chart: absorption coefficient for visible light wavelengths (400-700nm). Bars animate in from left. Red bar (700nm) is tallest at 0.65 m⁻¹. Blue bar (450nm) shortest at 0.013 m⁻¹. Bars colored by wavelength. X-axis: wavelength label. Y-axis: absorption coefficient. Title: 'Water Absorption Spectrum'.
scenes.framing: Chart occupies 80% of frame width. Caption strip below. Dark background.
scenes.movement: Bars animate in left-to-right over 0.8s. Red bar animates to full height last with slight emphasis pulse.
scenes.information_role: Visual proof of the 50x claim — the chart makes the disparity immediately intuitive
scenes.shot_intent: Data visualization that confirms the verbal 50x stat — viewers who process visually get their proof here

required_assets.description: Remotion bar chart component: wavelength absorption spectrum 400-700nm, bars colored by wavelength hue, animated build

scenes.description: Ocean depth scale infographic. Full ocean column from surface (0m) to average depth (3,688m). Narrow blue-tinted band at top: 'Sunlit zone: 0-200m'. Everything below is near-black. Label at right: '95% of the ocean — zero light'. Scale bar shows 200m vs 3,688m to emphasize how thin the lit zone is.
scenes.framing: Vertical infographic, centered. Labels animate in with narration. Caption strip at bottom.
scenes.movement: Depth column extends downward from surface over 1.5s. Labels fade in as column passes their depth. Dark zone grows from bottom.
scenes.information_role: The humbling scale reveal — 95% dark is the emotional climax, recontextualizing everything above
scenes.shot_intent: Make the viewer feel the enormity of the dark ocean relative to the tiny lit zone

required_assets.description: Remotion depth_scale_infographic component: animated ocean column 0-3688m, lit zone band, dark zone fill, animated labels

scenes.description: Closing card. Three lines phased in sequentially: 'The ocean's blue isn't reflected from the sky.' / 'It's built into the water itself.' / 'Blue is simply what's left.' Deep blue background with subtle upward gradient toward lighter blue at top. Final frame holds for 2s after last word.
scenes.framing: Center-aligned text stack. Title-weight first line, body-weight second and third lines.
scenes.movement: Lines fade in with 0.6s stagger. Hold final state. Fade to black on last 0.8s.
scenes.information_role: Core message delivery — the viewer now knows the real explanation and the sky-reflection myth is quietly corrected
scenes.shot_intent: Quiet, confident close. No call-to-action card needed — the last line IS the takeaway
